_comment: Worked Learn Mode example and FORMAT TEMPLATE. This is the mandatory keep-left sign. The current question bank has no matching question, so scripts/generate-explanations.mjs attaches it only if one is found (by the `match` hints); otherwise it stands as the authoring template. All prose is original plain-language wording of K53 / National Road Traffic Regulations facts.

original.question: When seeing this sign the driver knows that he/she must...
options: come to a complete stop before the obstacle
pass to the left of the obstacle on which the sign has been placed
pass to the right of the obstacle on which the sign has been placed

explanation.why: This is a mandatory 'keep left' sign - a blue disc with a white arrow angled down to the left. A blue disc is a command sign: it tells you what you must do. The arrow shows the side you must pass, and the sign is fixed to the island or obstacle it protects. So you must steer to the left of it. That is why the correct answer is B.
explanation.practical: As you approach the island or obstacle, stay in your lane, keep both hands on the wheel, guide the vehicle to the left of the sign and carry on straight. You do not stop or give way just because of this sign.
explanation.common_mistake: Passing to the right (option C) ignores the command and puts you on the wrong side of the island. Stopping (option A) is wrong too - a blue command sign is not a red prohibition or a triangular warning, and nothing here tells you to stop.
explanation.how_asked: In the test this is usually asked as 'what must the driver do?' or 'what does this sign mean?' - give the instruction the sign commands, here passing to the left of the obstacle.
